start.text: You found your way to my office. I'm Aoi. I own this building. And... other things. What do you want?

choices.text: I've heard about the club. I want in.

explore.text: Exploring is fine. But in this building, curiosity has a price. And a reward. Come back when you have a reason.

club_inquiry.text: The Pleasure Club. Members only. To join, you must prove yourself. Three trials. Each tests a different... appetite.

choices.text: I'm ready. What's the first trial?

hesitate.text: Intensity is the point. This isn't for the faint of heart. Or the closed-minded. Are you sure?

trial1.text: First trial: Surrender. You must let someone else take control completely. No safewords. No limits. Can you do that?

trial1_accept.text: Good. Riko will handle your first trial. She's... thorough. Come back when you've passed.

end.text: Remember: in this building, everything has a price. And everything has a pleasure.
